prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Quick-Guide Screen: Add a dedicated quick-guide screen before onboarding completes to demonstrate how to summon, hide, drag, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or interact with their desktop pet.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Reorder Story Before Path Selection: Reorder onboarding screens so the story introduction plays first, establishing world context before users choose their pet creation path. (why: Users take a long mean time on choose_path (514s); introducing the story context upfront sets expectations early.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Quality Check Flow: Introduce a new photo analysis screen during custom pet creation that checks photo lighting and clarity before rendering. (why: Support receives emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the adoption step drop-off.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Preservation Banner: Add explicit copy explaining that signing in links and preserves the user's newly created pet so it won't be lost. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, hint] Preset Pet Selection Carousel Guidance: Update the pet pick screen with a carousel layout and tip cards highlighting pet personality traits. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% and takes over 1000s mean duration.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification options on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Users spend long mean times on the waiting screen (2336s) and lose track of app progress.)

scores.note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion on control, but adding a screen requires new build.
Path selection already converts relatively well; reordering mostly targets high mean duration.
Adoption has the biggest drop-off (39.1%) and direct support mail evidence regarding photo quality issues.
Simple copy change directly addressing explicit user complaints about account/pet loss.
Adoption step drops 39.1% with long duration; guidance carousel improves choice clarity.
Extreme mean time on home screen (2336s) indicates idle drops that notifications can recover.
